title: Your agent says “done”. We check your app. · CheckMyApp
excerpt: After each deploy and every day, checkmyapp walks the journeys you choose on your live app and tells your agent what passed and what failed — with screenshots.
content_html:
After each deploy and every day, we walk the journeys you choose on your live app, and tell your agent what passed and what failed — with screenshots.

claude mcp add --scope user --transport http checkmyapp https://checkmyapp.dev/mcp

Sign in once: /mcp → checkmyapp → Authenticate.

Then tell your agent: “set up checkmyapp for this app”

Free account: $3 of checks, no cardWhy an independent check?See a whole check

Caught on real apps

joblander.appdaily check

Choosing a coach failed for everyone who signed in with email

Fixed that night

meetbashar.comdaily check

A linked YouTube video was unavailable in two places in the guide

Found by the daily check. The other 30 linked videos were available

Shopify apppilot

A direct link to the app opened a crash page with a stack trace

Reported to the app’s team

01

Connect your agent

Paste the command. Your browser opens once to sign in and allow it.

02

Hand over the journeys

Your agent sends them from your code, with a test user. Or we find them on your live app.

03

Connect your deploys

Install our GitHub App. Checks run automatically after each connected deploy.

Critical journeys: every deploy, whatever changed.

Mark the ones you can’t afford to break. Your other chosen journeys are checked daily and when their pages change — things break without a deploy, too.

Web apps

Public pages, and behind sign-in as your test user.

Chrome extensionspilot

Installed in Chrome, the way your users run it. Ask to join
